tools.name: capabilities
tools.description: Coverage areas, accepted question and shot types, refusal reasons declared up front, pricing and guarantees.

tools.name: check_feasibility
tools.description: Tells you BEFORE paying whether a request can be done, at what price and lead time, with an explicit refusal reason otherwise. Call this first. Modes: observe (closed questions, typed answers), watch (steerable log over a slot), capture (specified shots delivered under a licence).

tools.name: order
tools.description: Places an order. Returns a payment requirement when no proof is supplied.
